text:
incident-bot: PAGED: cont-batch::latency_spike (prod-us-west) — 20% p95 increase, 504s for some requests, KV cache eviction rate spiked x8. @roxanne you are primary oncall :rotating_light:
roxanne: seen. pulling up dashboards now. any customer reports?
ajay: CS reported 2 customers seeing timeouts ~13:22 UTC, sending heads-up.
mike: looks like concurrent in-flight went from 800 -> 3200 in ~90s. microbatch sizes collapsed to 1-2 and queueing piled up.
roxanne: hmm. prefetched KV entries grew then evicted rapidly. suspect prefetch heuristic loop under high QPS.
sre-lead: confirm impact: degraded latency for hosted API endpoint /v1/generate, affecting hosted customers on us-west-2. SLA risk.
lina: product-ops saying two paying customers hit 504s, opened tickets. we need immediate mitigation and postmortem.
roxanne: mitigation idea: temporarily disable prefetch on prod-us-west and bump microbatch_max to 128 to force batching. can we toggle feature flag?
ajay: flag name is `kb_prefetch_enabled` in flagstore. I can flip it to false for us-west. anyone object?
mike: do it. also push a queue-depth limit to avoid instant overload. set `contbatch_inflight_limit` from 5000 -> 2500.
roxanne: ajay please flip and set limit. I'll monitor.
ajay: running:
```
curl -X POST https://flags.redwood.internal/flip -d '{"flag":"kb_prefetch_enabled","region":"us-west","value":false}'
kubectl -n redwood patch configmap cont-batch-config -p '{"data":{"contbatch_inflight_limit":"2500","microbatch_max":"128"}}'
```

ajay: applied both. controller reports new config accepted.
mike: traffic stew still shows elevated queue length but microbatch sizes are now back up (mean 40). latency p95 trending down.
roxanne: good. temp rollback/trigger plan: keep prefetch off for 30m while we assess. schedule canary of a prefetch fix later.
sre-lead: notify support and customers: @lina please post incident update and mention rollback. also escalate if errors persist after 30m.
lina: sending customer messages now. draft: "We observed a performance regression in our request batching leading to intermittent timeouts. We've disabled prefetch in the affected region and applied queue limits to stabilize throughput. We'll provide updates in 30 minutes."
ajay: logs snapshot around spike:
```
[2026-02-18T13:22:11Z] INFO kv_prefetcher: enqueuing prefetch for key_range(12-34) size=4096
[2026-02-18T13:22:12Z] WARN kv_cache: eviction_rate=8200/s resident=0.4% used=95%
[2026-02-18T13:22:13Z] ERROR cont_batch: microbatch_size=1 inflight=3200 queue_depth=4500 latency_p99=4.2s
```

roxanne: we should also enable fallback routing to smaller model instances as a last resort (route policy: latency-first -> route to low-cap models). I'll open a routing override.
mike: ack. I'm watching for any regressions after flag flip. currently p95 back to ~230ms from 1.4s peak. 504s dropping.
roxanne: will follow up with hotfix plan: patch prefetch heuristic to cap enqueues per-second per-shard and backoff on evictions. propose patch and smoke in staging. assign to eng-ml.
sre-lead: assign task ENGML-4215 to Rohit (eng-ml) and include perf tests that simulate 3k concurrent small requests.
roxanne: handoff to daytime oncall in 20m: @mike you'll take over monitoring and timeline. I'll update runbook.
mike: got it. set escalation to infra-sre if errors reappear.
lina: customers notified. CS triage channel updated.
ajay: ops note: rolling restart of a small subset (10%) was performed earlier; not linked to this spike. leaving record.
roxanne: thanks team. we'll keep prefetch disabled until patch validated. postmortem to include root cause (prefetch storm + kvcache eviction feedback) and a list of config safeguards (inflight caps, microbatch floor, prefetch rate limiter). :white_check_mark:
